capabilities: Render the vault link graph with a deterministic breadthfirst layout
Open the corresponding note by clicking a node
Auto-refresh the graph when files are created, deleted, or renamed
Customize node and edge colors via an in-graph controls panel
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; manual installation instructions are provided.
intentEvidence: Unlike Obsidian's built-in graph view (which uses a force-directed simulation and rearranges itself every time you open it)
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph view uses force-directed simulation, so node positions rearrange every time the graph is reopened, making it hard to compare sessions or use as a stable visual index.
summary: Graph view plugin that renders the vault link graph with a deterministic Cytoscape breadthfirst layout that stays stable across sessions.
